attempts.summary: Created a loop-file-backed LVM stack on node1 (PV /dev/loop0 on /var/lib/lvm-backing/disk1.img, VG datavg, LV datalv), formatted ext4 and mounted it at /srv/data. Wrote test content, then grew the LV online from 800M to 2.15GiB (>2GB) using lvextend -r while mounted, verifying checksums matched before and after. Installed and enabled a systemd unit (srv-data-lvm.service) to reattach the loop device, activate the VG, and mount /srv/data at boot. Restarted node1 three times, hardening the boot unit after the first two hit udev/device-node race conditions, until the mount reliably recovers automatically; boot_id changed on every restart and checksums verified data integrity each time.
